summary: Verified hero SVG wobbly rings implementation. All 8 acceptance criteria pass: no raster filter present, 10 wobbly <path> elements render inside .hero-ring-pulse, 0 <circle> elements, path 'd' has 128 points with distance stddev ~2.65 (>0.5 threshold), CSS animation-name is 'heroRingPulse' with staggered delays (0s, 0.45s, 0.9s ... up to 4.05s per ring), transform matrix changes visibly across time samples (1.049 → 1.031 → 1.002), no horizontal overflow on desktop 1920 or mobile 390, and .blend-sphere is rendered (820x820, opacity 1, visible).
critical_code_review_comments: Unrelated observation: iTunes Search API fetches from the browser are blocked by CORS on every song lookup (many failing requests visible in console). Consider proxying via backend to avoid noisy console errors and failed network requests, though it does not impact the hero-ring feature under test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hero ring pulse (SVG paths, CSS keyframe scale animation) is verified working. Home page: waitUntil='networkidle' won't work because iTunes CORS-blocked fetches keep the network busy — use 'domcontentloaded' or 'load' with a short additional timeout.
